context: A barista and a customer chat about regulars from the neighborhood
purpose: Teach: 伊藤/吉田/松本/小林/村上/主婦/タバコ/入り口

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今日は伊藤さんも吉田さんもまだ来てないんですね。入り口の席、いつも誰かいるのに。
lines.en: Ito-san and Yoshida-san haven't come in yet today. The seat by the entrance always has someone.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone with a touch of warmth

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ええ、伊藤さんは雨の日は来ないんですよ。吉田さんは恐らく今日もお孫さんのお迎えでしょうね。
lines.en: Yeah, Ito-san doesn't come on rainy days. Yoshida-san is probably picking up her grandchild again today.
lines.style: Friendly barista voice, calm and chatty across the counter

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そういえば松本さん、最近お見かけしませんね。あの方、いつも入り口のすぐ横でタバコを吸ってらした方。
lines.en: Come to think of it, I haven't seen Matsumoto-san lately. The one who always smoked right by the entrance.
lines.style: Curious, gentle, recalling a familiar face

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 松本さん、ついにタバコをやめたらしいですよ。奥さんが専業主婦で、健康にすごく厳しい方なんだそうです。
lines.en: Apparently Matsumoto-san finally quit smoking. His wife is a housewife and very strict about health.
lines.style: Sharing neighborhood gossip warmly, slightly amused

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あら、それは偉いですね。小林さんのところの旦那さんも、確かやめようとしてましたよね。
lines.en: Oh, that's impressive. Kobayashi-san's husband was also trying to quit, wasn't he?
lines.style: Reacting with mild admiration, conversational rhythm

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 小林さんね、あれはあくまでも本人の意思次第ですけど、奥さんが結構うるさく言ってるみたいで。
lines.en: Kobayashi-san, well, it's ultimately up to him, but his wife seems to be nagging quite a bit.
lines.style: Light teasing tone, dropping voice slightly for gossip

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ふふ、村上さんは相変わらず元気ですか?あの方、毎朝同じ時間にいらっしゃるイメージで。
lines.en: Heh, is Murakami-san still doing well? I picture him coming in at the same time every morning.
lines.style: Light laughter, fond curiosity about a regular

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 村上さんは今朝も六時半きっかりにいらっしゃいましたよ。あの方がいないと、うちの一日が始まらない感じです。
lines.en: Murakami-san came in at exactly six-thirty this morning too. The day doesn't feel like it starts without him.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate tone about a beloved regular customer
